info.title: CDC Content Services Universal API
info.description: Access CDC Content Services resources, including syndicated media, topics, tags, audiences, languages, organizations, and source metadata from the public CDC Content Services API.

get.description: Retrieves media from CDC Content Services by ID.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: mediaId
parameters.description: CDC media identifier.

schema.description: CDC media identifier.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

geoTags.description: Geographic tags attached to the media item.

tags.description: Tags attached to the media item.

targetUrl.description: Target URL for the media item.

url.description: CDC API URL for this media resource.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
